notes.title: August Devlog! 🏔️
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]August has been an incredible month for [i]Heidi’s Legacy[/i] — from new features in the demo to our very first public showing at [b]Gamescom[/b]! Let’s dive in.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Brand-New Recipe Mini-Game 🍄✨[/h3][p]We’ve been working hard to implement a new [b]recipe system[/b] for the demo, just in time for Gamescom!
In this mini-game, you’ll combine [b]2, 3, or 4 ingredients[/b] by aligning them in the correct order to craft handmade goods. Bonus lines even give you [b]extra items[/b] - so planning your moves carefully really pays off.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/5b987a4705be170b0649c5738c8b43ad37b907ae.gif"][/img][/p][p]It’s a fun way to bring crafting to life, and we’re excited for you to try it in the demo.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Peek at Birgit’s House 🏡[/h3][p]Next up: more progress on our [b]3D-but-2D pipeline with Blender[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/04c1a639f4c9a21bbac05937c87f8a2dbc873c46.png"][/img]
This month, we shared a work-in-progress look at [b]Birgit’s cozy little house[/b] - complete with red roof tiles, flower beds, and a warm welcome. Soon, Adele will be able to go talk to Birgit and help her with various cooking quests![/p][p][/p][h3]Chickens, Goats… and More! 🐐🐔[/h3][p]Gamescom was fast approaching, and before we left, we shared a few more sneak peeks of our 3D models: a [b]chicken coop[/b] and a [b]picnic table[/b]. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/6206a5d53979c2b2ac857b60fb5331529714dbde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The chickens will be roaming in Birgit’s garden, while the picnic table will be used by Grandpa and others to gather and discuss at the end of the day.[/p][p][/p][h3]Adele’s First Time at Gamescom 🎉[/h3][p]And then came the big event! We showcased [i]Heidi’s Legacy[/i] for the very first time at [b]Gamescom 2025[/b] as part of the Indie Arena Booth - and what an experience it was![/p][list][*][p][b]Hundreds of players[/b] stopped by to try the demo, giving us incredible feedback (and plenty of goat love 🐐).[/p][/*][*][p]We met with many potential partners, opening new doors for the game’s future.[/p][/*][*][p]And of course, we caught up with lots of fellow dev friends — the [b]Indie Arena Booth[/b] community always makes this event so special! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/446ddec37b875410f808da6d5d8ff9a7c0326be5.png"][/img][/p][p]This was a huge milestone for us, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the excitement and support we received at the show.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stay in the Loop! 📌 [/h3][p]That’s it for August — a busy, heartwarming month for [i]Heidi’s Legacy[/i]. We’ll have more updates to share very soon, so if you haven’t already, don’t forget to [b]hit the “Follow” button[/b] on our Steam page. That way, you’ll get notified as soon as new devlogs and updates go live.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey with us 💚🐐[/p][p][/p][p]– Mélanie & Aurélien
[i]The Humble Reeds Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: July Devlog! 🏔️
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 👋[/p][p][/p][p]July has flown by, and we’ve been hard at work getting [i]Heidi’s Legacy[/i] ready for the big stage: [b]Gamescom 2025[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]
We’re thrilled to be part of the [b]Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2)[/b], and that means a [i]lot[/i] of preparation behind the scenes: printings for the booth, designing cards and stickers, scheduling meetings, and (of course) polishing the demo so it runs smoothly and bug-free for everyone who plays it in Köln ✨[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/2cbcc22475370665f5fdeb685d5591f164f0ca1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🐐 Bug Fixes: The Sliding Saga[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/d4e74a4d32304bfa28649f3a6474b19367f0a1f0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This month, we tackled a series of physics bugs that caused goats - and even Adèle - to slide around like they were on ice! While it was sometimes funny to watch, it’s not quite the peaceful mountain life we imagined 🙄[/p][p][/p][h2]🌫️ Bringing the Mountains to Life w/ Volumetric Fog
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/e5b9922eb1e7424e312dc857d5d089410625bd30.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]
[/b]To make the game’s atmosphere even richer, we implemented [b]volumetric fog[/b] across the mountain landscapes. Now, morning mist rolls down the hills, and sunsets feel more dramatic and immersive than ever![/p][p][/p][h2]🔥 Sneak Peek: Outdoor Bread Oven[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/42ecb97c0e998f7410c4d254e0dbf7ae51916afb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also working on new buildings, and here’s a little preview! We started modeling a [b]traditional outdoor oven[/b], inspired by real alpine designs. It’s still a work in progress, it’s quite hard to find a way to render stones while keeping the watercolor effect.[/p][p][/p][h2]📖[b] [/b]Journaling
[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650178/44eecb0adfee78915299fb37cdb452101177eb6f.png"][/img][/p][p]Similar to [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978150/Kamaeru_A_Frog_Refuge/"]Kamaeru[/url], the journal will come in handy to log every quest you have with the characters. We also made it so that the main page is a good recap of your mountain life so far 🐐[/p][p][/p][h2]📌 Stay in the Loop![/h2][p]We’re sharing devlogs like this one every month, and the best way to keep up with our progress is to [b]push the Follow button on Steam[/b]! That way, you’ll get notified as soon as we post something new.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support, and see you soon—maybe even in person at Gamescom! 💚[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Mélanie & Aurélien[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: June Devlog! 🌿
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! 👋[/p][p][/p][p]June was a big month for us two at Humble Reeds, and we’re excited to share everything we’ve been working on for Heidi’s Legacy with you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]📺 The Big Reveal[/b][/h3][p]First things first — Heidi’s Legacy was officially announced during [b]Wholesome Direct 2025[/b]! 🎉
We were so touched by the warm response and curiosity around our new project 💖 If you haven’t seen the announcement trailer yet, you can check it out here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nn9wiXLI_q0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚶‍♀️ Adele's Journey Begins[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfa5qq0S10TiQlEbpLQy8r6EeGqIxUcz8b5y-rCbQUSf_1yVvkDH3F_rAfsuHycORNbztoSxNi1WhttR5dpPM4e5bKMEqSmF2TcdbUqJeS0Gi9BJX-j77hu-MAl0t8zV64BqJNC_g?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]We kicked off the month by working on the [b]intro cutscene[/b], where our main character, Adèle, begins her journey from the city to the peaceful mountain village. But we don’t want to spoil too much about it yet![/p][p][/p][h3][b]⛏️ A Bit of Digging…[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeRM2ZlFY81gUC94GJqjopUrgyfDBetjqnzaGuUe_JW-BQ7LwjrI4NHVjzkq0sT31PC5jGP00k-WwW1YklXQq55wz35DuZ4syy-ss4AjU7KXSFL3eLE8ZzawJq2Ndf3cQUOr-a3TQ?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]We also made solid progress on the [b]digging mini-game[/b], refining its interface and making it more intuitive and satisfying to play. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎞️ Behind the Scenes: Adèle in Motion[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfSY4QJai0TiwCEM4h6cauEv122HCxcBcc7PEs4E6Pz4mfORzju729ZEYSND66bCqKT682OU_09IbH38XAdBIoN1uvlgAUfCdb1peG5I_z1h1yXyXN_AgT3QyEJN4yzzB5ZDHpE?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]Ever wondered how we animate our characters? This month we shared a peek behind the curtain: Adèle is animated in [b]Blender[/b], using a [b]3D skeleton[/b] but with [b]2D sprite assets[/b] attached! 
It's a hybrid approach that helps us keep the hand-drawn charm while allowing for smooth movement and quick iteration.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧀 Say Cheese! (QTE Style)[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfBSUug_zaxoyxNL1mhBSZMImICR8BSToUXaIgvbnPQ7l9Lal9k4zQ3uOJEsnmxuTSHCvGXGaRdpBkadTqy48FEqjQjv-i7yr5NZLli23w0jCalfLBBNYLAyLWeiY2YHUcoy1-z?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]Next up was the [b]cheese-making mini-game[/b]! We designed and implemented a [b]quick-time event (QTE)[/b] bonus system that will reward you with more products when you complete it. We still have to do some playtesting to get the timing just right![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌅 A Moving Sky[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfA3b2bx0fSl0K3dD3R_p1DC-MUmgJ7OIfJiuUqwQ2pvgwKDWpw1aI-61CMMu-rZH1TnbuaUfi5OK5JXwfjDsOmz-cUjtXm6M415QaDcXp2w_XWQNkK-TNVku6Y0EAAlYJylfOyGA?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]One of the most satisfying updates: we made the [b]skybox rotate[/b] to reflect the passage of time during the day. It’s a small touch that really brings the world to life.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧃 A Bit of Juice[/b][/h3][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeUsraoauqvTYARi3M37ZjL9CjgtrcXZX2DDztVnGjWU-j_2q3XnvCFdn9Bz0e-ttvhQojfZhNjQEVAFgBL_ofF4HHbDt99XcjUo2v7cECpuI5cuE76lScCldfRPHFXgvqHI4hL?key=mcJkiUTD4wcsN3Wg-gXyFqP_"][/img][/p][p]Finally, we gave some love to the [b]interface animations[/b]. Now, when you open a menu or interact with an element, the UI responds with a little movement — a bit of "juice" that makes every interaction feel more satisfying.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]And that’s a wrap for June! 🐐
Thank you so much for your support. Whether you're here for the cozy vibes, the game dev insights, or the goats, we’re happy to have you along for the journey.[/p][p]👉 Don’t forget to [b]follow[/b] the game here on Steam to catch future devlogs and updates![/p][p]With love,[/p][p]
Mélanie & Aurélien[/p][p]
[/p]
